supplies.analysis: The supplies share of the annual procurement budget should be 30% of €10 million, which is €3 million. Given the constraints, we will design the supply procedure to ensure that no lot exceeds €221,000 and that no single lot carries more than 60% of the procedure's value. We will also ensure that the total budget share of the proposed lots does not exceed 60% of the total budget allocated to supplies. The procedure will be competitive, and each lot will include a sustainability criterion.

orchestration_result.final_recommendation: For the €10 million annual procurement budget, the supplies will be allocated €3 million (30%). The supplies will be divided into lots with values not exceeding €221,000, ensuring no single lot carries more than 60% of the procedure's value. Each lot will include a sustainability criterion. Services and works proposals were out of scope and thus not included in the final recommendation. The award criterion will be based on the best price-quality ratio with weights of price 60%, quality 40%. The supplies lots are: Office Supplies (€150,000, 0.05 share), IT Equipment (€200,000, 0.067 share), Furniture (€180,000, 0.06 share), Maintenance Tools (€130,000, 0.0433 share), Vehicles (€170,000, 0.0567 share), Safety Equipment (€165,000, 0.055 share), and Consumables (€145,000, 0.0483 share).
